| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|

| `getArray()` | Deprecated. |
| `getAtIndex(int index)` | Gets local NPC at index specified |
| `getInteractingWith(int playerIndex)` | Gets a list of NPC's that are interacting with a given player index. |
| `setIgnoreHealth(boolean ignoreHealth)` | Setting this to true will allow for NPCs with 0 health to show up in closest(Filter) and all(Filter) calls. |

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `isWithCycleCheck()` | When true, all() will only return projectiles with an end cycle greater than or equal to the current game cycle. |
| `npcIsTargeted(NPC npc)` | Checks if there is a projectile targeting a given NPC |
| `playerIsTargeted(Player player)` | Checks if there is a projectile targeting a given Player |
| `setWithCycleCheck(boolean withCycleCheck)` | When true, all() will only return projectiles with an end cycle greater than or equal to the current game cycle. |
